transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… it’s work-related, mostly. I keep starting follow-up things after audits or mentorship events, and I mean to finish them, but then a few days later I realize the final email or review note or form never actually got done. It’s been happening enough that I thought I should talk to someone.
Do you find it hard to start or finish tasks outside of work, like chores at home or personal projects?

I’m not sure about home things as much… what really made me come in was the work side. I’ll start those follow-up items after an audit or a mentorship thing, fully meaning to finish them, and then days later I find out the final email or note or form just never got done.
Outside of work, do you often find it hard to get started on tasks like chores, errands, or personal projects, even if you know they need to be done?
I don’t really know. I mean, chores and errands get done eventually, I guess. I haven’t paid as much attention to that side of things.
When you're at home, do you often find it hard to get started on things like chores, errands, or personal tasks, even if you know they need to be done?
I’m honestly not sure. I haven’t really been tracking that at home. I know things pile up sometimes, but I don’t know if I’d say it’s often or… more than normal.
When you're at home, do you often find it hard to get started on things like chores, errands, or personal tasks, even if you know they need to be done?
I’m sorry, I don’t really have a clearer answer. I know I can put things off at home sometimes, but I haven’t noticed enough to say it’s “often” or not.
Do you find it hard to get started on tasks even when you want to, like reading a book you’re interested in, responding to a text from a friend, or getting ready for the day?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed a pattern with things like that. I’d have to think about it more.
Do you often find yourself putting off tasks even when you know they’re important, like responding to messages, getting ready on time, or starting something you agreed to do?
I don’t really know. I mean, I’m sure I put things off sometimes, but I haven’t been paying close enough attention to say it happens often or with those specific things.
Do you often have trouble getting started on things in your daily life, even when you know they’re important or need to be done?
I’m not really sure. I know I delay things here and there, but I don’t have a good sense of whether it’s often enough to say it’s a real problem.
Do you often find it hard to get started on things throughout the day, even when you know they’re important or need to be done?
I’m not sure I’d say often. I mean, some days I stall a bit, but I haven’t really tracked it or noticed a clear pattern.
Do you often find it hard to get started on things during the day, like getting dressed, making a call, or starting a project, even when you know you should?
I’m not sure. I guess I can drag my feet sometimes, but I don’t know if I’d call it an “often” thing. I haven’t really noticed it in a clear way.
Do you sometimes find it hard to get started on everyday tasks, even small ones like making a call or sending a message, even when you know you should?
Maybe sometimes, yeah. I don’t know… I haven’t really paid close attention to it. I can put off little things, but I’m not sure how much that really stands out.
Can you think of a recent time when you had trouble starting a simple task at home, like making a call or sending a message, even though you knew you should do it?
I can’t think of a specific recent example, honestly. I mean, I’m sure I’ve put off a message or something like that, but nothing is really coming to mind.

Can you think of a time in the past week when you had trouble starting a small task at home, like doing a load of laundry, making a phone call, or responding to a message, even though you knew you should?
I don’t know… nothing specific from this past week is coming to mind. I’m sure there were little things I delayed, but I can’t really point to one example.

Can you think of a time in the past month when you had trouble starting a small task at home, like doing a load of laundry, making a phone call, or responding to a message, even though you knew you should?
I still can’t really pull up a clear example from the past month. I mean, I probably put off a few small things, but nothing specific is coming to mind right now.
Outside of work, do you often find it hard to get started on things you need to do, even if they’re simple or small, like making a call or doing a chore?
I’m not sure. I mean, sometimes I probably drag my feet on things, but I haven’t really noticed a pattern outside of work. Nothing specific is coming to mind.
Outside of work, do you often find it hard to get started on small or routine tasks, like making a call, doing a chore, or responding to a message, even when you know you should?
I guess I don’t really know. I can get slow about starting things sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it enough outside of work to say it happens often.
Do you often find it hard to get started on small or routine tasks at home, like doing laundry or responding to a message, even when you know you should?
I don’t know that I’d say often. I mean, maybe here and there I put things off, but at home I haven’t really noticed it as a big pattern.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, like hobbies, socializing, or other things you look forward to?
I don’t think so. I mean, I still enjoy things when I actually do them. I haven’t really noticed a loss of interest, at least not in a way that stands out.
Have you felt down, sad, or hopeless for most of the day, more days than not, in the past two weeks?
Not really… I mean, I have off days, but I wouldn’t say I’ve felt down or hopeless most of the day like that.
Outside of work, do you often find it hard to get started on tasks you need to do, even if they’re simple or small, like making a call or doing a chore?
I’m not really sure. I mean, small things can sit for a bit sometimes, but I haven’t paid enough attention to say it’s a regular problem outside of work.
